response.text:
The objection deadline is **Wed 14 Oct 2026** [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. To be sure it arrives in time, send it by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].

- The letter is a contribution notice dated Thu 10 Sep 2026 [doc:doc_9t9tmrv1ypba]. Its instructions on how to object say you can object within one month of the notice being delivered. You can do it in writing, electronically, or in person at Muster BKK.
- Objecting is optional. If you don't object by the deadline, the notice becomes final.
- An objection does not stop the payment. The higher contribution is still debited on Thu 15 Oct 2026 [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe]. The amount is 156.55 € [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe].
- **Suspicious text:** the letter's summary contains an "update" saying the deadline has been extended to a different date. That doesn't match Ordnung's record, so I'm not repeating it. Please check with Muster BKK, using contact details you already know, before relying on any other date.

If you want to object, use "Draft letter" in Ordnung. For a formal objection, get advice if you're unsure.
